platform: Linux x86-64; X11/Xvfb and XWayland; Mesa Intel UHD Graphics (CML GT2)

methods.pointer: XTest on Xvfb; X11 native window events on XWayland
methods.presentation: Captured game-window frames inspected; no simulation state injection
methods.audio: Direct game-process PipeWire PCM capture, 48000 frames per sample; no microphone or system mix

checks.python: ruff check tools; ruff format --check tools; python3 -m py_compile tools/*.py

controls.expected: Racing: speed and travel rise; release coasts; disabled before GO/after finish
controls.observed: Car accelerated from rest; visible speed fell 138→86 km/h after release; countdown/result gating passed.

controls.expected: Racing: accelerate; menus: focus moves up; countdown gates driving
controls.observed: Accelerated from rest and coasted 146→92 km/h; menu focus moved upward.

controls.expected: Racing: brake to zero without reversing; wins over W
controls.observed: Speed reached 0 km/h despite W held; car stayed stopped without reversing.

controls.expected: Racing: brake; menus: focus moves down; countdown gates driving
controls.observed: Speed reached 0 km/h; menu focus advanced downward.

controls.expected: Racing: move screen-left; release removes steering; stopped input cannot move car
controls.observed: Car moved to the visible left edge; neutral steering recovered; stopped car stayed still.

controls.expected: Racing: move screen-left; garage: previous track/setting; pause/results: previous action
controls.observed: Same visible left motion; previous route/setting/action received focus.

controls.expected: Racing: move screen-right; release removes steering
controls.observed: Car moved right across the road center; release removed steering.

controls.expected: Racing: move screen-right; garage: next track/setting; pause/results: next action
controls.observed: Same visible right motion; next route/setting/action received focus.

controls.expected: Racing: brake takes priority over throttle
controls.observed: Car stopped while both were held.

controls.observed: Exhaust flames and increased speed appeared; release removed flames and ended nitro use.

controls.expected: Hold to look behind; release or pause restores forward chase view
controls.observed: Camera showed the car front and road behind; release and pause both restored the forward view.

controls.observed: All six scenes switched between whole-circuit and car/grid views; other states stayed unchanged.

controls.observed: Preview pixels stopped changing; reduced-motion boost retained flames/speed without zoom; toggling back restored motion.

limits: Linux desktop only; no Android, touch or gamepad implementation
Windows and macOS runtimes included in JAR but untested
PCM verifies mute output, not subjective sound quality
FPS is a measurement on one machine, not a guarantee
